sim.method: Additive ESPN PPG/OPP blend (current + prior pseudo-games), injury offense hits (retain 0.45, cap 14.0), home +2.5/2 each side, Normal scores σ=11.5 with shared pace shock, OT resolves ties. 10000 sims/game.
sources: ESPN injuries + athlete pages (PPG when available)

props_sim.method:
* Game logs (ESPN athlete gamelog, regular season) for current season, using only games
    BEFORE the slate date; prior season used as a shrinkage prior (5 pseudo-games for
    minutes, 150 pseudo-minutes for per-minute rates).
  * Minutes ~ Normal(mu, sd) clipped [0, 46]; sd = max(4, blended sample sd).
  * Teammates Out/Doubtful (ESPN injuries feed, live slates only): minutes +15% of their MPG
    (cap +4) and stat rate x (1 + 0.30 * their share of team production), cap +12%.
  * Opponent/pace: team projected score from the game sim / team PPG baseline
    (points use the ratio, reb/ast use its sqrt), shrunk halfway, clipped 0.9-1.1.
  * Shared game shock (same-game legs): pace z ~ N(0,1) scales every rate by 1+0.05z, and a
    shared margin draw ~ N(sim spread, 12) cuts minutes 10% in blowouts (|margin| > 18).
  * Counts ~ Gamma-Poisson (overdispersed) around minutes x rate x adjustments.
